items.author: Tichafara Mabiza, Nov 16
items.summary: "Court Vision 25-26" turns the NBA's player-tracking data (every player and the ball, five times a second) into a Tableau Data App with shot replay, a scoring heatmap and a 3D season view. He built it with Tableau Data Apps and Tableau Studio in about 5 to 6 hours. 29 reactions, 3 comments, 3 reposts.

items.author: Andy Rapaport, Nov 16
items.summary: "Federer54" tells Roger Federer's career story (1,526 matches; he won about 80% of matches but only 54% of points) as a Tableau Data App. He argues Data Apps let you build the whole experience, not just standard chart types. [App](https://lnkd.in/ghEfDNzn). 5 reactions, 1 comment.

items.author: Michael McCusker, Nov 16
items.summary: A Grand Theft Auto franchise-history exploration (timeline, units shipped, reviews) built entirely with Tableau Data Apps, in a dark, game-styled layout. [App](https://lnkd.in/gDkszQci). 9 reactions.

items.author: Sourin Rakshit, Nov 16
items.summary: Asks whether vibe-coded Data Apps inherit governance. Tableau says they use the same permissions as other assets, but hasn't said whether apps run as the viewer or the owner, or how row-level security applies. His advice: test as a restricted user and keep apps in an exploratory tier until certified. No counts shown yet.

items.author: Ashish Modi, Nov 16
items.summary: Says Tableau developers need to rethink what's possible in UX and UI with Data Apps. He points to Tableau's two Data App galleries (Cloud and Tableau Next), which show approvals, batch email, write-back, audit trails and scenario planning. No counts shown yet.
